instruction: I need to convert the receipt image (OIP.jpg) in my home directory to a PDF file. Please save the converted document as "document.pdf" on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'document.pdf' on Desktop. Evaluator checks file at /home/user/Desktop/document.pdf has 1 page, proper size, and image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the PDF file from the expected location (/home/user/Desktop/document.pdf)
Metric correctly verifies PDF has exactly 1 page, appropriate for single image-to-PDF conversion
Content verification checks file size (>10KB) to ensure PDF is not empty or corrupted
Image detection logic correctly verifies PDF contains embedded image data by checking for /XObject with /Image subtype
Postconfig sleep (2 seconds) allows file system to settle after conversion operation
All instruction requirements are fully covered: correct output location, PDF format, and valid content from source image
